segments.title: Main News Desk: Trump Portrait, Ukraine, Redistricting, Israel
segments.notes: Case Blackwell and Jeff Ripple cover Trump's new White House portrait, Ukraine peace talks, Texas congressional maps, California redistricting response, and Israeli settlement expansion.

segments.title: Interview: Portrait Artist Dick Bob Buick

segments.title: Debate: Knock-Knock Jokes vs. Yo Mama Jokes
segments.notes: Munch and Crum debate joke formats while trading personal barbs about Crum's missing penis, Munch's key from the devil, and Belulia at Coachella.

segments.title: Late News with Liliana & Hate Sock

segments.title: Science of Hamstering
segments.notes: Chet and ChetAI analyze the biomechanics of the hamstering sex trend, comparing it to milking tables and discussing double-sunroof logistics.

segments.title: Street Interviews: National Guard, Hamstering, Cybertrucks
segments.notes: Trip Bradstein interviews park-goers on National Guard deployment, hamstering trend origins, and a Cybertruck dealership owner.

segments.title: Breast Milk Ice Cream Musical Finale & Raid
segments.notes: DJ Newsic performs an R&B song about breast milk ice cream, thanks subscribers, and raids Gina Darling.

episode_summary: Case Blackwell returns from a week away to anchor a chaotic Wednesday broadcast covering Trump's new White House portrait, stalled Ukraine peace talks, Texas redistricting, and Israeli settlement expansion. Jeb Nogget's instructional segment on sidewalk cruising and news anchoring is hijacked by Hype Train's rap tutorial. Portrait artist Dick Bob Buick claims a gay Mormon genie fused a brush to his hand. Munch and Crum debate knock-knock versus yo mama jokes while advancing the hell-key storyline. Liliana and Hate Sock close the news with a Jake Paul fight, Bigfoot exhibit, pony donation, Ozempic for dogs, and the hamstering trend, prompting Chet and ChetAI to analyze the biomechanics. Trip Bradstein interviews park-goers on National Guard deployment and hamstering. DJ Newsic ends the stream with a breast milk ice cream anthem and a raid to Gina Darling.
